datasetInfo.source: Simulated cognitive learning trajectories calibrated to student mastery models
datasetInfo.splitStrategy: GroupShuffleSplit by student_id to prevent data leakage

limitations: Trained on educational progression models; accuracy improves as more empirical QuizCraft AI student attempts are recorded.
Requires at least 2 historical quiz attempts for reliable prediction; cold-start behavior triggers when insufficient attempts exist.
Predictions are probability estimates and do not guarantee future test scores.
